description: List all Cloudflare D1 databases in the account. Returns each database's UUID, name, creation date, table count, and the DSN to use with other litescope tools. Requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID environment variables. Read-only.
name: litescope_d1_list

databases.description: Each D1 database with uuid, name, table count, and dsn.

title: List D1 databases
